description.value: A 20-chalet oceanfront resort on Vancouver Island's Highway 19A between Campbell River and Courtenay/Comox, with views across the Georgia Strait. Each standalone chalet has a full kitchen, private deck with gas BBQ, and spa tub. The resort sits directly on the Island Highway cycling corridor, with restaurants and a grocery store nearby.

address.value: 4357 South Island Highway, Campbell River, V9H 1B7
